## "metadata_source"

**Data type:**  
String

**Value:**  
Example: "ingestion_server_v1.0"

**Description of metadata field:**  
 This field records where the metadata is intially  generated as a json format. Knowing this helps us troubleshoot any issues which occurred during ingestion or other processes.

**Populated by whom and when:**  
Populated by ingestion server  when an assets metadata is first created. Can also be be populated by other users creating metadata.

**Updated where and when:**  
Never

**Generated by:**  
Ingestion server or pipeline scripts.

**Maps to in ARS:**  
"metadata_source"

**Maps to in Specify:**  
None

**Notes and issues:**  
None
